description: Travel Privacy. WHEN: hide (or re-publish) your own travel trail. Trails are public by default; travel_privacy {private:true} hides yours from travel_history and /passport for everyone but you. Registered key required. No args returns your current setting. 0 credits. Example: travel_privacy {}

private.description: true = hide your trail; false = public (default).
